d: A maintenance engineer lays his life on the line to save his daughter and other passengers on a plane hijacked by terrorists. He uses the help of an air-hostess in an effort to foil their plan.
Chaman, a lecturer, has trouble finding a suitable bride due to his receding hairline. Chaos ensues when an astrologer predicts that he will remain celibate if unmarried till the age of 31.
Sameera finds her life crumbling when her teenage neighbour Vivek hacks into all her social media after she rejects his advances.
The lives of four individuals - a father, his pilot daughter, a prostitute, and a migrant worker - are thrown into turmoil when the Indian government announces a nationwide lockdown.
